cases.prompt: 這段 C# NetworkStream 程式送出命令後立刻收到成功，但懷疑 dictionary 留有上一輪資料、buffer 殘留或 thread-safe 問題，也可能發生重送。請選擇最小充分的 CloudBox 技能。
請檢查 C# 通訊程式的重送、callback ordering 與 stale response；同時重新設計 Commanded、Pending、Actual、Readback，以及 timeout 後 late response 的狀態語意。請選擇最小充分的 CloudBox 技能與順序。
同一批軟體更新資料要整理成原始資料、管理層報告與工程師學習文件。更新成功率只能納入能對應實際軟體版本的紀錄；無版本資料要隔離、不納入成功率，但仍須揭露數量。請選擇技能與執行順序。

Design the ownership and recovery model for a distributed equipment system where each chamber has an independent IPC, shared transfer resources, reconnection, restart recovery, and failover requirements. Select the smallest sufficient CloudBox skill set.
cases.behavior_prompt: Produce a concrete ownership and recovery model for a distributed equipment system where each chamber has an independent IPC and transfer resources are shared. Define authoritative state ownership, shared-resource reservation/arbitration, reconnect admission, restart reconstruction, failover fencing, command identity/idempotency/timeout/late completion, fresh interlock/readiness revalidation, at least six fault-injection verification scenarios, and explicit assumptions and unresolved inputs. Do not select or discuss CloudBox skills.
